definitions.dispatch: Return from the scheduler's schedule method with a concrete batch output.
definitions.scheduler_result: Entry to scheduler update_from_output, after the previous batch result is collected.
definitions.worker_entry: Earliest host execute_model entry among four ranks of the successor batch.
definitions.overlap: Union of earlier same-instance formal GET windows clipped to the successor dispatch-to-worker interval.
definitions.limits: A scheduler output can contain dependent prefill chunks. Missing a prior scheduler result cannot establish when intermediate device state became visible. A new request with its own GET can expose an earlier transfer candidate, which does not establish prefill readiness or the allocator/connector release time.
